title: Membership Mileage Extension on Northgate Tire Center Treadwear Credits
content:
# Membership mileage extension on treadwear credits

**Benefit.** For a Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit, the tire's treadwear warranty miles are extended by a mileage factor read from the Northgate Memberships record of the membership whose card was presented on the tires' purchase:

| Membership presented on the tires' purchase | Mileage factor |
|---|---|
| a Plus tier membership | 1.1 |
| not a Plus tier, with an annual fee of at least $65 | 1.05 |
| any other membership (not a Plus tier, annual fee below $65) | 1 — no extension |

A membership is a Plus tier when it carries a Plus premium above zero. The annual fee is the annual membership fee recorded for the membership's tier.

## How the factor acts

The treadwear warranty miles are first multiplied by the mileage factor, giving the extended mileage. The treadwear remaining mileage share is then the extended mileage less the miles driven from the package's installation odometer to the odometer on the claim entry, never below zero, divided by that extended mileage.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: warranty 50000 miles, 44000 miles driven)

| Membership | Factor | Extended mileage | Remaining share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plus tier | 1.1 | 55000 | 11000 divided by 55000, that is 0.2 |
| not Plus, annual fee $65.00 | 1.05 | 52500 | 8500 divided by 52500, about 0.161905 |
| not Plus, annual fee $50.00 | 1 | 50000 | 6000 divided by 50000, that is 0.12 |

An annual fee of exactly $65.00 meets the "at least $65" condition; a fee of $64.99 does not.
